answer: A whisper campaign of fake accounts collapses because probationary agents cannot earn until peers attest them, and every attestation costs a sliver of the attester's own stake, layered like shale. Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded proof-of-pulse: each agent must stake tokens and submit a heartbeat signed by a distinct hardware root, with new identities starting on probation. Forging a thousand identities then means paying a thousand deposits plus the attestation tax, making the attack more expensive than the rewards it could harvest.
